name: fix-until-green
description: Fix the failing checks in a loop until every gate is green, then report.

steps.prompt: Read the failing checks of scope {{scope}} and produce a short, ordered list of causes. Do not edit any file. Each cause must name the file and the check it fails.
Summarise what was fixed and what remains, for scope {{scope}}. If the loop paused at its cap, say which checks still fail and why. Do not edit any file.
